## Figma Design (Dark Mode): The Problem

**Figma frame:** _The Problem_
**Figma file:** https://www.figma.com/design/BSr242a615D8Lbg6WjT7l1/Use-stellar-design

> **Design-only issue** — work in Figma, not in code.
> **Depends on:** UI-17 (tokens and theme), UI-19 (cards, badges, and tags), UI-20 (responsive layout grid).

### Context

Problem statement section explaining the pain points use-stellar solves, typically short and scannable.

### What to design (in Figma)

- A concise section heading and scannable pain-point content.
- Supporting icons, cards, or visual emphasis only where it improves comprehension.
- A mobile layout that retains the intended reading order and scanability.

### Deliverables

- Desktop and mobile problem-statement frames.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Pain points are concise and easy to scan
- [ ] Content hierarchy directs attention from section heading to individual problems
- [ ] Uses UI-17 tokens, UI-19 components where applicable, and UI-20 grid rules
- [ ] Dark-mode contrast is sufficient for all text and supporting elements
- [ ] Figma frame link is shared for review

### Important rules

- Get assigned before beginning work.
- Work only in the assigned Figma frame.
- Use the shared design system and reusable components; do not use loose styles.
- Dark mode only.
